items.title: How much does a silent naming bug cost while it goes undetected?
items.description: The `flag` bug wasn't caught by a crash or an error log — it silently skipped reminders for overdue customers, month after month, until someone in Billing noticed collections had dropped. Drag the sliders to see how the number of missed reminders grows the longer a silent bug like this goes undetected, and how much a single month's worth of overdue customers matters to that total.

params.name: monthsUndetected
params.label: Months before the bug is noticed

items.compute: const missedReminders = params.monthsUndetected * params.overdueCustomersPerMonth; return { missedReminders };

outputs.label: Overdue customers who missed their reminder
